name: oracle-frontend
description: Frontend-engineering bundle for Claude Code: the three official Chakra UI v3 skills (chakra-ui-builder, chakra-ui-migrate, chakra-ui-refactor) repackaged from chakra-ui/chakra-ui@main plus the @chakra-ui/react-mcp server pre-wired. Install once per FE sub-directory (--scope local) and Claude Code auto-loads the skills and the MCP server. Replaces the per-dir 'npx skills add' workflow with a single 'claude plugin install' call. Chakra Pro blocks are opt-in via CHAKRA_PRO_API_KEY env var in the consuming project's .env.
